fields.label: Active Admission Year
fields.description: Used when an applicant has no academic year.

fields.label: Register No Pattern
fields.description: Placeholders: {abbr} company abbreviation, {yy} / {yyyy} start year of the admission year, {program_code} program abbreviation. Must end with the counter, e.g. {####}.

fields.label: Roll No Pattern (optional)
fields.description: Same placeholders as the register number; use a different prefix so the counters are separate.

fields.label: Strict Seat Matrix
fields.description: When on, a program and year without a Seat Matrix, or a quota and category without a row in it, cannot be admitted into unless the user holds Admission Override (the override is logged). Supernumerary quotas and quotas not counted in the matrix are never checked.

fields.label: Reporting Deadline
fields.description: Last day to join for the students admitted in the current admission round. Each student keeps the deadline in force when admitted. A joining dated later needs an approved Late Joining Request.

fields.label: No-Show Grace (Days)
fields.description: Days after the reporting deadline before an admitted student who has not joined is listed as a no-show and referred for cancellation (a draft Admission Cancellation; nothing is cancelled automatically).

fields.label: Program Reporting Deadlines
fields.description: A program listed here uses its own deadline instead of the round's.

fields.label: Acknowledge a Number Once Per (Hours)
fields.description: A number that already received the enquiry acknowledgement inside this window gets none. 0 disables the check.

fields.label: Acknowledgements Per College Per Hour
fields.description: Past this ceiling the enquiry is still saved but no WhatsApp acknowledgement is sent. 0 disables the ceiling.
